description: This file defines the 'Authenticator' interface for authentication mechanisms within the OFBiz framework, including methods for initialization, authentication, user synchronization, password updates, and configuration flags.

classes.name: Authenticator
classes.description: Interface for authentication implementations, specifying methods for user authentication, synchronization, password management, and configuration.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the authenticator with a LocalDispatcher instance.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username, password, and service flag.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out a user by username.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the authenticator for ordering.

methods.name: isUserSynchronized
methods.description: Checks if the user is synchronized back to OFBiz.

methods.name: isSingleAuthenticator
methods.description: Indicates if this is the only authenticator.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the authenticator is enabled.
